about: A path dependency written as a dotted key, and one inherited from the root [workspace.dependencies] (inline, dotted or as a table; its path relative to the root), is a crate edge; an inherited registry dependency is none

files.Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
members = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.dependencies]
serde = "1"
b = { path = "b" }
d.path = "d"
